heroLabel: A LITTLE CREATIVITY, A LITTLE LOVE
heroDescription: Find a frame you love, add your favorite moments. Let Photobooth take care of the rest.
private: Your photos stay on your device
emptyResults: No frames match your search just yet.
editorTitle: A little you. A lot of memories.
editorDescription: Select a photo slot to adjust it. Good things start here.
uploadHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP · up to 20 MB each
libraryHint: Select a photo to fill the selected slot.
noPhotos: Your favorite moments will appear here.
cropHint: Drag to reposition your photo. Use the zoom slider to adjust the area you want to keep.
confirmDelete: Delete this photo from the tray and all slots using it?
complete: All filled. Ready to keep this moment!
limit: Up to 30 photos and 32 megapixels of working images per session. Remove photos to add more.
lowResolution: Some photos are small; your keepsake may look a little soft.
error.format: Use a still JPEG, PNG or WebP image. Convert HEIC to JPEG first.
error.size: This image exceeds the 20 MB limit.
error.pixels: This image exceeds the 40 megapixel limit.
error.decode: We couldn’t read this image. Try another file.
error.animated: Animated images aren’t supported yet. Please use a still image.
error.export: We couldn’t create your image. Try again or choose a smaller size.
error.exportTimeout: Image processing exceeded 15 seconds. Try again or choose a smaller size.
error.share: We couldn’t open the share sheet. Try again or open the generated image to save it.
error.camera: Camera unavailable. Check permission, close other camera apps, or upload photos instead.
finishDescription: A little gift for you, and everyone in the picture.
downloaded: Your image is ready and the download has started.
newSessionConfirm: Starting over clears your current photos and edits. Continue?
jpegNote: Images are optimized before download at the selected resolution. High-quality JPEG gives smaller files; PNG uses lossless compression and supports transparency.
cameraDescription: The most natural moments are the loveliest.
singleCaptureHint: Take one photo per round. Choose a higher count to shoot a burst.
burstCaptureHint: Each round will take {{count}} photos in a burst.
paused: Capture paused. Your photos so far are safe.
reviewHint: Uncheck photos you don’t want. Photos enter your tray only when you choose to use them.
captureFailed: Camera interrupted. Your captured photos are safe. Try reconnecting.
localNote: No photo uploads · Photos are cleared when you leave
slotHelp: Tap or click a slot to select. Drag your photo or use the adjustment sliders.
designTitle: Your frame. Your layout. Your story.
designDescription: Choose the decoration and photo layout independently. Make a combination you love.
livePreview: Preview of your selected frame and layout
noMatches: No matches. Try changing or clearing your filters.
homeEyebrow: A LITTLE PHOTOBOOTH, A LOT OF HAPPINESS
homeDescription: Turn everyday photos into little keepsakes. Find your frame, open your camera, and save a moment that is entirely yours.
homeCollectionDescription: Soft, romantic, or a little nostalgic? Explore {{frames}} frame styles and {{layouts}} layouts. Make a combination that feels like you.
homeInviteDescription: A smile, a date, or simply a really lovely day.
setupSubtitle: Choose your frame on the left, add your photos on the right. Your story comes together in the middle.
setupActionHint: A little lovely thing to take with you.
error.artwork: Artwork could not load. Check your connection and reload.
mobileSetupHint: Choose Frame, Layout and Photos below. Tap an empty slot to add a photo, or a filled one to edit.
